identity.name: Avijeet Thakur
identity.nameRule: Always 'Avijeet Thakur', one spelling. Never 'Abhijeet' in prose (the email address abhijeet62966@gmail.com is an identifier, not prose).
identity.promise: A full-stack web developer who also thinks like a product manager: sites, stores and AI automations that rank, convert and keep working.

market.languageRegister: Plain English, short sentences, no idiom that assumes a native speaker. First person singular. Concrete nouns and numbers over adjectives.
market.publicLocation: Not shown on the site (owner decision 2026-10-19).

modes.name: Plain proof
modes.example: Two WordPress sites, 30 to 40 pages each. Leads up 55%, inquiries up 27%.

modes.name: Direct build
modes.example: I take the Figma file and ship a fast, responsive site with SEO already in place.

modes.name: Calm advice
modes.example: Start with the page that earns the most enquiries, then fix speed.

voice.humourPolicy: None on service pages. A dry line at most once per page elsewhere.

palette.accentRule: The accent (Volt) marks the one thing that matters on a surface: the primary action. Never decoration.
contrastLaws: Volt #C6F432 is a fill with Midnight text, or text on Midnight. Never Volt text on Mist or Paper.
Sky #5CC8FF is a background glow only, never text.
Slate #5B6573 on Midnight fails; on dark use #A9B4C6.
Light fill, dark text; dark fill, light text. 4.5 to 1 minimum, verified.

truth.rule: No published fact may originate anywhere else. If it cannot be traced, ask.
forbiddenClaims: Any self-reported star rating or AggregateRating markup
Any testimonial or client quote not supplied and approved in writing
Any result figure beyond those in docs/BRAND-TRUTHS.md
Client logos or names beyond the live projects listed in the CV
Revenue, earnings or user-count figures for client businesses
Team size or agency framing (this is one person)
Certifications beyond those listed in the CV
